query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM value_scenario_responses) as total_responses,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM value_evaluations) as total_evaluations,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cumulative_waveforms) as total_waveforms,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM digital_twins WHERE personality IS NOT NULL) as total_twins_with_personality;
